name: @justeattakeaway/pie-code-connect
description: Figma Code Connect templates and configuration files for PIE web components

scripts.code-connect-publish-components:web: yarn code-connect-build:web && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-web-components-batch.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-components:react: yarn code-connect-build:react && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-react-components-batch.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-components:vue: yarn code-connect-build:vue && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-vue-components-batch.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-components:all: yarn code-connect-publish-components:web && yarn code-connect-publish-components:react && yarn code-connect-publish-components:vue
scripts.code-connect-publish-icons:web: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn code-connect-build:web && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-web.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-icons:react: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn code-connect-build:react && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-react.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-icons:vue: COMPONENT_PREFIX=icons- yarn code-connect-build:vue && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-icons-vue.config.json
scripts.code-connect-publish-icons:all: yarn code-connect-publish-icons:web && yarn code-connect-publish-icons:react && yarn code-connect-publish-icons:vue
scripts.code-connect-publish-components:dev: yarn code-connect-build:web && yarn figma connect publish -c ./config/figma-dev-components-batch.config.json

author: Just Eat Takeaway.com - Design System Team
